crossRefs.note: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn, and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the…
Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
Jesus answered him, “Most certainly, I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”

parallels.note: Into whatever city you enter, and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.
But into whatever city you enter, and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,
Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

translations.web: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
translations.bsb: Truly I tell you, anyone who does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.”
translations.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.
translations.asv: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall in no wise enter therein.
